'''Eshan''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was a member of the [[Six Sisters]], a group of worlds governed by the [[Echani Command]] confederation. During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the Echani fought against the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], who threatened Eshan. In [[1154 BBY]], the celestial body [[Begali]] launched a [[Begali Uprising|rebellion]] against the Six Sisters; however, it eventually renewed ties with Eshan.

==Description==
Eshan was a terrestrial<ref name="Terrestrial" /> [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-2-ancient-coruscant|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 2 - Ancient Coruscant}}</ref> located in the [[Eshan system/Legends|Eshan system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA Eshan" />

==History==
Eshan was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="KOTOR2" /><ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Near-Human]] offshoot [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> During the [[Mandalorian Wars]]<ref name="KOTOR2" /> of [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture threatened Eshan, and in response the Echani, who had a combat-focused culture of their own, fought against the aggressors. Later, during the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="KOTOR2" /> of [[3959 BBY]]&ndash;[[3956 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] successfully disrupted the stability of the Echani worlds.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="3951 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] conversed with one of the Echani [[Handmaiden Sisters]] serving [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Atris]]. The Jedi Exile claimed that if the Handmaiden Sister had been serving Atris&mdash;who had opposed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] involvement in the Mandalorian Wars&mdash;during that conflict, the Jedi Master would have forbidden the Echani from fighting to defend Eshan.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
{{Endgame}}

By [[1154 BBY]], Eshan was one of the [[Six Sisters]], a group of worlds governed by the confederation known as the [[Echani Command]]. Although the celestial body [[Begali]] severed its ties with Eshan when it launched a [[Begali Uprising|rebellion]] against the Six Sisters that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], it went on to renew the relations with the Echani homeworld less than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later&mdash;although Begali's ally,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the planet<ref name="GaW" /> [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]], continued its own struggle for independence from the Echani Command for more than one hundred years.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Echani homeworld was threatened by the Mandalorians. Yet you fought.''"<br />"''We did, but not against our teachings or our Masters&mdash;we fought with them, united.''"<br />"''You realize if you served Atris then, you would not have fought for your homeworld&mdash;she would have forbidden it.|A possible conversation the Jedi Exile, the player character in ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'', can have with a Handmaiden Sister|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
[[File:Kotoriibox.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Eshan was introduced, albeit unnamed, in ''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords''.]]
The Echani homeworld was first mentioned in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. In the game, the world can be mentioned in an optional conversation the player character, the Jedi Exile, can have with one of the Handmaiden Sisters. This article assumes assumes one hundred percent game completion and that the conversation took place as described.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' later introduced the name "Eshan,"<ref name="CSWE" /> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Eshan [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA Eshan" /> [[Jason Fry]], one of the co-authors of ''The Essential Atlas'', subsequently confirmed that Eshan was the Echani homeworld.<ref>{{JCFCite|url=posts/30683247|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-01-10|time=5:58 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802110601/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-133#post-30683247}}</ref>

A mention of Eshan that would have established its status as a world was originally meant to be included in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned Eshan was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the world was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
